title: Reelhouse: Slot Machine Sound Effects
shortText: 126 slot machine SFX: 5 reel stops, 5 win tiers with coin cascades, bonus wheel, 25 loops. WAV + OGG.
html:
One slot cabinet, every sound it makes

126 slot machine sound effects in WAV and OGG for any game engine (Unity, Unreal, Godot, GameMaker, RPG Maker and HTML5): the lever, buttons, coins, tokens and a note acceptor; the reels spinning at three speeds, a stop for each of 5 reels building into the last, near misses, nudges and holds; 5 win tiers from a small win to the jackpot, each with a matching seamless coin cascade loop; the hopper, the credit meter, the jackpot bell and a multiplier in 6 steps; a bonus wheel and free spins as whole lifecycles; the cabinet's hum, attract mode, power, tilt and door; and 6 casino floor loops. Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. A free demo of 17 sounds is on this page.

Licence, up front

Royalty free. Commercial use. No attribution required. Use it in as many games as you like, on any platform. The one thing you may not do is resell or redistribute the sounds themselves as a sound pack. The plain language terms ship as LICENSE.txt, with a copy and paste credit line for anyone who wants one. Everything is synthesised from code, so there is no upstream sample licence behind it.

Hear it first

There is a free demo on this page: 17 sounds copied unaltered from the paid files. One whole spin (a coin in, the lever, the reel motor starting and the spin loop), all 5 reel stops, a near miss, three win tiers from small to the jackpot with the middle coin cascade loop, and the jackpot bell starting, ringing on and stopping.

One cabinet, one sound

Reelhouse is one electromechanical slot cabinet, every part of it: a sheet steel body, a chromed lever, motor driven reels, an electric bell, a coin hopper paying into a steel tray, banks of lamp relays and a mechanical credit meter. Everything the player touches is heard close, at the cabinet; the floor loops are the room it stands in. Every sound plays as delivered, named by what fires it, for slot roguelikes, casino minigames, fruit machines and any game with a reel in it.

Built for the way a slot game fires sounds

  • A stop for each reel: reel_1_stop to reel_5_stop, each landing brighter than the last so the line builds into the final reel,

plus 4 stop takes for reels you do not count, and a seamless anticipation loop for the last reel still turning.

  • 5 win tiers, 5 cascades: win_1 to win_5 ring the bell longer and drop more coins tier by tier, and each tier has its own

seamless payout_cascade loop to run while the coins pour, a trickle to a flood.

  • Speeds and steps as ladders: the reels at three speeds, the credit meter at three speeds, the multiplier in 6 steps. Every

loop ladder shares one length and one structure, so a game can crossfade between rungs.

21 ladder steps measured from the shipped files, failing steps: 0.

Whole lifecycles

  • Lever: pull, return, locked
  • Note acceptor: accept, reject, stack
  • Reel hold: engage, release
  • Coin hopper: start, run (loop), stop, empty
  • Jackpot bell: start, ring (loop), stop
  • Bonus wheel: start, spin (loop), slow, stop
  • Free spins: award, enter, exit, retrigger
  • Power: on, off
  • Tilt: warning, trip, reset
  • Cabinet door: unlock, open, close, lock

No two states of one mechanism are the same sound renamed (38 pairs measured from the shipped files, 0 alike).

Everything in the box

  • 23 controls and coin entry sounds: three lever pulls, the return and a locked lever, spin buttons, bet one and bet max, cash out, coins going in 4 ways, rejected coins into the return cup, brass tokens, and a note acceptor taking, refusing and stacking a note.
  • 30 reel sounds: three spin loops, reel starts, the 5 counted stops and the stop takes, the anticipation loop, nudges, a reel hold, near misses, a skill stop, no win settles, and scatter and wild landings.
  • 37 win and payout sounds: the 5 win tiers and their 5 cascade loops, the hopper starting, running, stopping and running empty, coins landing in the tray, coin scoops, credit ticks and three credit meter loops, the jackpot bell, a lamp chase loop and the 6 multiplier steps.
  • 13 bonus sounds: bonus triggers, the bonus wheel from start to stop with single peg ticks for a wheel your game drives itself, and free spins awarded, entered, retriggered and exited.
  • 17 cabinet sounds: the idle hum and attract mode loops, power on and off, the tilt warning, trip and reset, the cabinet door with its key, fault buzzes, a call attendant loop, a reel jam and a cabinet bump.
  • 6 casino floor loops: a quiet floor, a busy floor, the high limit room, an arcade floor with coin pushers, the back office and a coin counting machine.

Fit

  • WAV and OGG for every file, 16 bit, 44.1 kHz, mono, with a naming manifest listing every file by group.
  • 25 seamless loops with loop points in both formats, and none on a one shot.
  • 20 variation sets whose takes differ in length and in brightness.
  • One loudness band: the inner 80 percent of the pack sits inside 1.77 dB, so a credit tick and a jackpot share a mix.
  • Import notes for Unity, Unreal, Godot, GameMaker, RPG Maker and the web, and pack_proof.json with a sha256 and a measurement for every file: 1169 checks, 0 failed.

Already own our other sound packs?

Every file here was measured against every file in the studio's 6 nearest packs (clockwork and the machine room, cards and the table, clicker feedback ladders, roguelike loot, motors and machines, doors, locks and mechanisms: 105336 pairs, on spectral shape and on envelope, each tolerant of a transposition): 105336 of 105336 are separate sounds. The proof ships in the download as cross_pack_proof.json.

Honest limits

These are synthesised sounds designed for games, not recordings of a real cabinet: sheet steel, chrome, bakelite, nickel coins, brass tokens, a steel bell, a steel tray, relays, motors and noise. There is no music here: no win tunes, no jingles, no reel melodies; the wins are mechanical, bells, coins and relays, and the bell is one struck pitch. There are no voices, crowds or announcers, and no cards, chips or dice. The figures above are signal measurements, not a claim that anything sounds good; that is what the free demo is for.

AI disclosure, stated truthfully: the code that generates these sounds was written with AI assistance. The sounds themselves are self contained procedural synthesis by Core Systems Asset Factory, with no generative audio model at any point. The cover is an AI generated illustration, and the store plates are drawn by AI written code from the pack's own waveforms.

More from the same studio

  • Jackpot, generated slot machines for GameMaker, the reels these sounds were made to play under.
  • High Table 01, a casino croupier voice pack, for the voices this pack leaves out.
  • Felt Table, a card game and deckbuilder UI kit, for the table games beside the slots.
  • Shuffle and Tell, deckbuilder card table sounds: cards, chips and the table.
  • Tally, clicker and idle feedback ladders, for the numbers that climb.
  • Escapement, clockwork, brass and the machine room, more machinery in the same spirit.
